title: 66th NAHC Annual Conference
description: The National Association of Housing Cooperatives' yearly national gathering of housing co-op members, board members, managers, and professionals — NAHC calls it its biggest gathering of the year. The 2026 program opens with a keynote on housing cooperatives in Puerto Rico facing a new generation of challenges, then runs concurrent sessions on board roles (treasurer, secretary, board-only sessions), co-op finances, fair housing, and harassment prevention, plus an exhibit hall, a group luncheon, and a first-time attendee orientation. Held at the Wyndham Grand Rio Mar resort in Río Grande, about 30 minutes from San Juan. Open to non-members: late-rate registration is $1,175 for non-members and $1,075-$1,100 for NAHC members, by registration form with prepayment; refunds ended September 25. An optional Registered Cooperative Manager certification course runs beforehand, Nov 2-3, for an extra fee.
